proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Government Financial Support and Access to COVID-19 Vaccines and Therapeutics
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to report on whether and how government financial support for Janssen's COVID-19 vaccines and therapeutics is considered when setting prices and access.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the adoption of this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Independent Board Chair
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management LLC on behalf of Oneida Trust Minors
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Civil Rights Audit
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management LLC on behalf of Christopher and Anne Ellinger
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party civil rights audit of corporate policies, practices, products and services to assess racial impact and recommend improvements.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the adoption of this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Executive Compensation Bonus Deferral
proposals.proponent: Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia
proposals.topic_summary: Urges the Committee to be able to withhold and defer part of executive annual bonuses for adjustment during a deferral period to reduce excessive risk-taking.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
